title: Configuration and options — concept map
intro: ASP.NET Core configuration merges key-value settings from JSON files, environment variables, user secrets, and cloud vaults into IConfiguration. The options pattern binds sections to strongly typed classes injected via IOptions, IOptionsSnapshot, or IOptionsMonitor. Later providers override earlier ones. Production APIs validate at startup, store secrets in Key Vault or K8s secrets, and use IOptionsMonitor for hot-reloaded feature flags.

overviewDiagram.title: Configuration to options pipeline
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  JSON[appsettings.json] --> MERGE[IConfiguration merge]
  ENVJSON[appsettings.Environment.json] --> MERGE
  SECRETS[User secrets / Key Vault / K8s env] --> MERGE
  ENV[Environment variables __] --> MERGE
  CLI[Command line] --> MERGE
  MERGE --> BIND[Bind / Configure T]
  BIND --> VAL[ValidateOnStart]
  VAL --> OPT{Options interface}
  OPT --> IO[IOptions static]
  OPT --> SNAP[IOptionsSnapshot per request]
  OPT --> MON[IOptionsMonitor hot reload]

conceptCards.title: Configuration providers
conceptCards.summary: Pluggable sources merge into IConfiguration. Default chain: JSON → env JSON → user secrets → env vars → CLI. Last wins. Env vars use __ for :.

conceptCards.title: appsettings layering
conceptCards.summary: Base appsettings.json plus appsettings.{Environment}.json overlay selected by ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT. Defaults to Production if unset.

conceptCards.title: Options pattern
conceptCards.summary: Configure<T> binds section to POCO. IOptions cached singleton. IOptionsSnapshot scoped per request. IOptionsMonitor CurrentValue + OnChange for reload.

conceptCards.title: Configuration binding
conceptCards.summary: Get<T> and Bind map keys to properties. DataAnnotations + IValidateOptions<T>. ValidateOnStart fails host before traffic.

conceptCards.title: Secrets management
conceptCards.summary: User secrets local dev only. K8s secrets as env vars in containers. Azure Key Vault with managed identity in production.

conceptCards.title: Hot-reload config
conceptCards.summary: reloadOnChange on JSON providers. IOptionsMonitor.OnChange updates singletons. Feature flags yes; connection strings usually need restart.
